hook_text: A tea bag, a dice and a cereal box walk into a recycling depot. Which one is a pyramid?
clip_script: Recycling day in Bloemfontein! Cereal box: six rectangles, two matching ends. A rectangular prism! Dice: six squares. A cube, a special prism. Gift box: square base, four triangles meeting at the top. A square-based pyramid! And the tea bag? Four triangles. A triangle base, so it is a pyramid too: a tetrahedron! Name a pyramid by its base, every time.
visual_style: Packaging dropping into labelled bins, with faces lighting up and unfolding briefly to show their shapes.
mood: Quick and fun, like a sorting game show.
pacing: Rapid sorting, a pause on the tea bag puzzle, then the reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three 3D objects in your kitchen.
